verdict: The two marks are the same mark: round dots, 6 px across on an 8 px pitch, sitting on the same six rows (47–52 and 121–126), in the same salmon red, under the same four words, with DRAFFT left bare in both. states.verdict: This is about the same mark in both. Both draw real round dots, not a wave, 6 px wide on an 8 px pitch and 6 rows tall, in #ED766B.
